hypothesis: Add Pre-Commitment Demand Thermometer — 5-signal demand scoring protocol that reads market temperature BEFORE any resource commitment
what_changed: New Phase 0 workflow with 5 demand signals (Search Demand Pulse, Complaint Density Scan, Wallet Trail Detection, Ghost Offer Test, $20 Smoke Test) producing 0-100 demand score with go/no-go thresholds (Blazing/Warm/Lukewarm/Cold/Dead). Routes to appropriate existing workflow based on score.
gap_identified: All signal-reading in current skill happens AFTER resource commitment. Pattern 2 (Validation Before Polish) means 'build ugly and test' — but you still build. No structured protocol for reading demand at zero cost before ANY build step.
benchmark_task: Design a launch strategy for Authority Flywheel's first public offering — predictable demand before commitment
notes: Extends Samuel's '$289 budget is strategic' hidden knowledge to its logical pre-build extreme. The strongest improvement was Intent Alignment (+3) because the benchmark specifically asked for pre-commitment demand reading. Adversarial +3 because the Honest Scoring Test and Zero-Build Test prevent hope-based launches. No existing workflows were modified.
